description: Demolition of existing shed and enlargement of existing rear extension
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed single-storey side extension, by reason of its size, scale, bulk, and detailed design, would result in an overly large, disproportionate, and poor quality extension that would be out of character with the architectural design of the original dwelling and the wider terrace, particularly when combined with the existing extensions to the property. The proposal would fail both to represent good design and preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. As such, the proposal fails to comply with policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets), and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and policies D3 (<span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Optimising capacity through the design-led approach</span><span style="text-align: justify;">), D4 (Delivering good design), and HC1 (</span><span id="docs-internal-guid-d48a9eb8-7fff-4266-e5a9-720c51317033"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Heritage conservation and growth</span></span><span style="text-align: justify;">) of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-64d3ebf2-7fff-c951-d03b-e8f7c9e87fb8"></span><br></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-19c64928-7fff-5d66-4d6a-9f638456dcfd"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The single-storey rear extension, by reason of its excessive size, bulk, and scale, in combination with the existing side infill extension,&nbsp; would have a harmful impact on the amenities enjoyed by the neighbouring residents of no. 36 Forburg Road through a loss outlook and would result in an increased sense of enclosure that would be experienced at the basement level. The proposal, therefore, fails to comply with policy D6 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Housing quality and standards</span><span style="text-align: justify;">) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), and Hackney's&nbsp; Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-05c3b471-7fff-02a1-c571-de236297d06d"></span><br></span></p>
